notes: THE CARD. Isaiah Collier '26: 11.7 points and 7.2 assists in 25.7 minutes over 59 games, usage 20.4, TS .567, BPM -2.4. Ball-security inputs: TOV% 19.6, USG 20.4, AST% 39.2, and 13.1 assists against 4.6 turnovers per 100 possessions — an assist-to-turnover ratio of 2.85.

WHY recal_192's DECLINE WAS RIGHT AND STILL IS, ON ITS OWN TERMS. ballsec = 1 - [(1-w) x Padj + w x Praw]. The subject's two legs are fixed facts of his season (Padj 0.556, Praw 0.983), so his pre-smoothing card is 44.5 - 41.8w and the printed number is 0.75 x that + 0.25 x a rookie year that reads 13.1 - 11.7w. At w = 0 — the raw leg DELETED — he prints 37 and the band opens at 40. NO re-weighting of the two legs can land this ruling, and that is not a tuning failure but arithmetic. What his amendment changed is not the subject's arithmetic: it released the ceiling on the ANSWER, and the answer had to be a third thing under the blend rather than a fourth way of mixing two percentiles.

WHY A FLOOR AND NOT A LOUDER CREDIT. His amendment asked for a credit 'that saturates', and a floor is the saturating credit in its strongest form: max(base, floor) pays a man nothing once he is already above it. That single property is what closed the eleven doors recal_192 measured. The elite ball-keepers (Jordan '88 95, Billups '06 89, SGA '25 94, Steve Kerr '96 86, DeRozan '17 90) are at or above their own floors and move by EXACTLY zero; the ball-stoppers (Westbrook '15, Harden '19, Jordan '88 again) take floors of 1 to 6 because their AST/TOV sits at the bottom of the creator class; and the order pin recal_192 died on WIDENS, because the season with the WORSE ratio ('97, 3.43) sits further below its floor than the season with the better one ('01, 3.53) and therefore takes the larger lift.

THE CLASS IS THE POINT, AND IT IS recal_192's OWN FINDING TURNED INTO A TERM. 'AST/TOV 2.85 is the 90.1st percentile of 2026 — but only because the league median (1.50) is set by men who never pass.' So the floor reads the ratio inside the class that the statistic means something in: the season's own creators. The subject sits at 0.78 of his class where he sat at 0.90 of his league, and Calderón '09 sits at the top of his. The square then separates them 0.61 to 1.00, which is exactly the ratio his two rulings ask for (45 against the high 80s).

WHAT THE FLOOR ACTUALLY PAYS, AND TO WHOM. 330 of 10,000 cards move. The largest are one archetype and read like it: Jason Kidd '09-'12, Ricky Rubio '14-'16, Rajon Rondo '11-'19, Mark Jackson '98-'01, Nate McMillan '87-'88, Muggsy Bogues '89-'97, Kendall Marshall '14, T.J. McConnell '20, Andre Miller '15, Chris Paul '25 — low-usage distributors whose raw TOV% was being read as though they were ball-stoppers. Their OFF gains 4 to 6 and their OVR 2 to 4.

THE SUMMIT DOES NOT CHANGE HANDS, which is the failure recal_116 and recal_192 both named. The ballsec top 12 is Al Jefferson '12/'13/'14/'15, Michael Jordan '97/'98, Mike Mitchell '88, Steve Novak '13, Alex English '88/'89 and Dirk Nowitzki '16/'17 — BYTE-IDENTICAL to main's, and to the list recal_192 recorded. Muggsy Bogues '90 reaches 89 and Jason Kidd '10 reaches 78; neither is near it, because the floor's ceiling is 89 and every man above that got there on the raw fact. An UNGATED floor read against the whole league instead of the class hands the summit to Sidney Lowe, Pablo Prigioni and Lester Conner — measured, and the reason the class and the gate are both in the term.

THE ONE PLACE THE FLOOR WAS TOO LOUD, AND WHAT FIXED IT. An ungated floor pays anyone with a tidy ratio, and the man it overpaid is Mike Conley '24 — AST/TOV 4.39, the cleanest ratio in the 2024 class, on AST% 28.4 and USG 16.0. He went 48 -> 74, Minnesota's offence went +1.40 while Boston's pinned five went +0.32, and recal_119's BOS '24 OFF rank <= 10 (zero slack) went to 11. The class's own interquartile range of AST% is 27.5 to 35.5, so the gate is read there: Conley 0.11, the subject 1.00, Calderón 1.00. A gate can only SHRINK a floor, so it cannot lift Westbrook — recal_192's other wall, the one every creation-VOLUME key ran into, stays shut.

THE OFF SIDE IS NOT THIS LANE'S AND WAS NOT TOUCHED. data/compute_ovr.py changed by ONE line, the PIPELINE_VERSION constant. Every OFF and OVR move on the board is the 0.10 ballsec weight in o_score and recal_121's turnover charge relaxing for men who now clear its ball-security gate.
